scenario_meta.description: A floating embassy rises and sinks with the tide while linguists, smugglers, ambassadors, and memory divers trade endangered languages as political assets. Build loops around translation rights, ritual protocols, archive access, forged idioms, cultural debts, and diplomatic scandals.

player_entry_points: A disgraced scholar seeking to restore their family name.
A merchant whose trade permits are written in a language they cannot read.

creator_conflict_hooks: The discovery of a scroll that invalidates the current ruling dynasty's lineage.
A sudden flood in the lower archives threatening to erase the only record of a peace treaty.

extra_world_events.title: Proclamation Draft Discovered
extra_world_events.description: A preliminary draft of the Grand Proclamation, with critical redactions, has surfaced in the Phonetic Sluice. A disgraced scholar could exploit this to alter history or expose secrets before the deadline.

extra_world_events.title: Censor's Watch Escalates
extra_world_events.description: The Censor's office has tightened scrutiny in the Syntax Exchange, making document alteration riskier. An informant's methods could be revealed, or a scribe coerced to aid redaction.

extra_world_events.title: The Lexical Gauntlet Posted
extra_world_events.description: A challenge for a 'Dialect Duel' has been posted in the Syntax Exchange, demanding rare idioms to impress neutral ambassadors. Public opinion is shifting, demanding a champion.

extra_world_events.title: Ambassador's Favor Sought
extra_world_events.description: Neutral Ambassador Lyra has expressed interest in a forgotten dialect from the Archive of Lost Vowels, potentially swaying the 'Dialect Duel'. A disgraced scholar might uncover it.

extra_world_events.title: Archive Leak Threatens Vowels
extra_world_events.description: A minor but persistent leak has been detected near the Vowel Stasis Pods in the Archive, threatening to dissolve stored phonetic sigils. Archivist Elara is concerned.
